services.name: Helicopter tour
services.desc: The Helicopter Operations Support and Fleet Driver will support aircraft for Powerline work, Forestry, Rowcrop and other contracts as needed. This position will perform duties assisting helicopter operations through safely and efficiently operating company fleet vehicles, fueling aircraft, and hooking and removing long lines. The position requires confidence in and around helicopter operations, maintaining alertness to multiple concurrent activities, and a commitment to safe and conscientious commercial motor vehicle operations. Experienced in safely operating trucks with a Gross Vehicle Weight Ratings (GVWR) up to and over 26,000 lbs. Maintain state-issued Class A Commercial Driver’s
